verdicts.reason: Both layouts are almost the same, and both are broken. The small cross icon has been blown up into a huge, blurry pixelated cross in the middle of the banner, so it becomes the main focal point and pulls attention from the headline. The dates are jammed against the top edge. 'Worship & Bible Study' floats on its own between the cross and the illustration. The invite copy is pushed down to the bottom edge, which leaves dead space. B is slightly worse because its dates and the 'Worship & Bible Study' line are set with tighter, cramped letter spacing that is harder to read.
